name: Ocean tuna
summary: Ocean tuna, also called cá bò gù, is the fish Phú Yên led the country in catching. The plate to order is thin cold slices rolled in mustard greens with wasabi, chilli sauce, soy, herbs, green banana, and ginger.
origin: Phu Yen. The province led the country in catching ocean tuna.
texture: Thin cold slices, rolled in mustard greens as cá ngừ cuốn cải xanh.
howToEat: Roll the slices in mustard greens with wasabi, chilli sauce, soy, herbs, green banana, and ginger.
Other tuna plates in town include gỏi bao tử, lườn cá nướng muối ớt, bao tử cá ngừ hầm tiêu xanh, and cháo cá ngừ. The eye is a dish of its own.
where: Lê Duẩn and the bờ kè Bạch Đằng riverbank, and the corner of Điện Biên Phủ and Lê Duẩn.
seoTitle: Ocean tuna in Tuy Hoa — slices in mustard greens
seoDescription: Cold ocean tuna slices rolled in mustard greens with wasabi and ginger, on Le Duan and the Bach Dang bank in Tuy Hoa.
